name: Eiscafé Dolomiti
kurzbeschreibung:
**Ice Cream Café Dolomiti in Füssen**

Welcome to **Eiscafé Dolomiti** in the charming town of **Füssen**, where we craft authentic Italian gelato with the finest Alpine ingredients. Our creations are made fresh daily with natural flavors, from classic **Vanille** and **Schokolade** to unique specialties like **Dolomiten-Honig** and **Almkäse**.

Enjoy your gelato in our cozy café or take it to go—perfect for a sweet break during your visit to **Schloss Neuschwanstein**, a short stroll away. Whether you're exploring **Tirol** or simply indulging in a moment of pleasure, our gelato is the ideal treat.

Come by and taste the difference—**Dolomiti** style!
